questions.question: Which overflow value displays scrollbars only when the content actually exceeds the container dimensions?
questions.explanation: overflow: auto adds scrollbars only when content exceeds container boundaries, keeping UI clean when content fits.

questions.question: What is the primary advantage of max-width: 100% over width: 100% for images?
options: It prevents images from scaling larger than their natural size while allowing them to shrink responsively
questions.hint: Prevents pixelated stretching beyond natural resolution.
questions.explanation: max-width: 100% lets images shrink to fit narrow screens without stretching them beyond their intrinsic resolution.

questions.question: Which modern CSS property maintains consistent width-to-height proportions (such as 16/9 or 1/1) without padding hacks?
questions.explanation: aspect-ratio defines a preferred aspect ratio for the element box across all modern browsers.

questions.question: What happens when an element with overflow: visible has content larger than its set dimensions?
options: The text automatically shrinks font size
The content spills outside and renders past the container boundaries
questions.explanation: By default (overflow: visible), content spills out beyond the container's box boundaries without clipping.

questions.question: Which property horizontally centers an element with a max-width within its parent in modern CSS logical properties?
questions.explanation: margin-inline: auto (equivalent to margin: 0 auto) centers an element horizontally along its inline axis.
